description: This Java class defines the Spring configuration for a batch job that processes transfer fee charges for loans. It sets up beans for a step, the job, and the tasklet that performs the fee transfer logic, leveraging various service dependencies.

classes.name: TransferFeeChargeForLoansConfig
classes.description: Spring configuration class that sets up the batch job, step, and tasklet for processing transfer fee charges on loans.

methods.name: transferFeeChargeForLoansStep
methods.description: Creates and returns a Spring Batch Step object for the transfer fee charge process, using the specified tasklet.

methods.name: transferFeeChargeForLoansJob
methods.description: Creates and returns a Spring Batch Job object that runs the transfer fee charge process step with an incrementer for job instance differentiation.

methods.name: transferFeeChargeForLoansTasklet
methods.description: Creates and returns an instance of TransferFeeChargeForLoansTasklet, injecting necessary services.
